extracted.name: Apple Chutney
extracted.description: An old recipe of my mother's. Great on cooked eggs, hamburgers. Better than store bought relish.
instruction_lines: Using a food processor, chop everything fine.
Add everything to a large pot and cook on medium low heat for 2 hours.
Put in canning jars leavinf half inch head space. Process in a water bath for 10 minutes and allow to cool. Ensure jars have sealed properly.
